# Description

Summary of the change and the related issue(s).

- Resolves # (issue)

## Type of change

- [ ] Docs / planning
- [ ] Website content or build
- [ ] AI tool (Comms Assistant / FTA Explainer / SIP)
- [ ] Config / tooling

## Safety checklist

- [ ] No invented statistics, board names, or FTA details. Sourced material only.
- [ ] Any AI-drafted content has a named human reviewer before it can publish.
- [ ] The live `inzbc.org` site was not edited or published.
- [ ] No secrets, `.env*`, or credentials committed (secret scan run).
- [ ] Relevant docs/specs updated to match.

## Review

- [ ] I went through the diff; all changes are intended and necessary.
- [ ] Tests / checks run where applicable.
